description: This vertical bar chart illustrates the results of an ablation study, measuring a performance metric titled "Recall@10" across four different configurations. The horizontal category axis displays the evaluated conditions, with text labels slightly rotated and ordered from left to right as "Ours", "- critiquing", "- scoring", and "- ranking". The vertical value axis measures the Recall@10 metric on a linear scale with a visible range from 0.1 to 0.4. The axis features numeric tick labels at regular intervals of 0.1, accompanied by horizontal grid lines extending across the chart area at 0.2, 0.3, and 0.4. The data is represented by four individual vertical bars that are not sorted in strict ascending or descending order. The first category, "Ours," is visually emphasized with a solid orange bar and represents the tallest value in the chart at approximately 0.35. The remaining three categories are represented by solid blue bars. The "- critiquing" bar has a height corresponding to roughly 0.29, while the "- scoring" bar represents the shortest value in the chart at approximately 0.17. Finally, the "- ranking" bar has an approximate value of 0.23.
